description:
The easy to use, easy to love smartphone
If you want an easy to use smartphone that makes staying connected with family and friends both fun and reassuring, then you'll love the Doro 8100. Conversations are clearer with Doro's optimized sound quality, and our intuitive interface simplifies everything you want to do. Three lenses and a simplified camera menu make it easy to capture spectacular images, including great portraits and low light shots. And two pre-installed apps enable trusted contacts to provide support if you need it. name: Samsung Galaxy Xcover6 Pro 16.8 cm (6.6") Hybrid Dual SIM 5G USB Type-C 6 GB 128 GB 4050 mAh Black
description:
Do more with confidence. Galaxy XCover6 Pro
Built to be durable, secure, and productive, Galaxy XCover6 Pro gives pros the confidence to do more in the field and beyond.

Awesome performance to do more at once
Galaxy Xcover6 Pro combines Octa-core processing power with 6GB of RAM for fast and efficient performance for the task at hand. Enjoy 128GB of internal storage and add up to 1TB more with microSD card.

Lightning speed wherever you go
The XCover6 Pro will keep you ahead. Out in the field or inside the office, the XCover6 Pro supports 5G as well as Wi-Fi 6E for hyper-fast connection anywhere, anytime.

Optimized display experience with large screen and super smooth scrolling.
Take in more, all at once. The Galaxy XCover6 Pro's 6.6-inch large Display gives you room to see and do more. With FHD+ technology and a 120Hz high refresh rate, the content you see every day will look smoother and sharper.

Durable to a new extent
The XCover6 Pro's IP68 water and dust-resistance rating and MIL-STD 810H-grade durability takes it anywhere you need to go.

Keep an extra life ready with replaceable battery
With its 4,050mAh (typical)*] replaceable battery, Galaxy XCover6 Pro gives you long-lasting power. When you need a quick power-up, either swap it out with a fully charged extra battery or use the 15W Fast Charging charger. Plus, you can get to charging quickly and conveniently with the POGO pin.

Seamless swiping in harsh conditions
Through rain, the XCover6 Pro will respond. With heightened touch sensitivity, the XCover6 Pro stays touch-responsive even when your hands are damp or when you've got leather gloves on.

Protect what matters to you
Built into the phone's hardware and software from the start, Samsung Knox protects your phone from the minute it's turned on. Offering multi-layered security, it defends your most sensitive information from malware and malicious threats.

Customize your go-to key
Make your day easier. The XCover Key can be customized to fit your tasks and frequent uses by setting it for specific purposes, including Push-to-Talk, barcode scanning, certain apps and more.

Multi-task without the hassle
Take the office with you with DeX. The XCover6 Pro offers the convenient switch to a large screen from wherever the work takes you. Simply connect your device onto an external display and get to your PC tasks right away.

Stay connected in the field
Communication is clear and seamless with PTT on the XCover6 Pro. With the speaker volume now louder than ever, you can make sure you and your team are staying in sync on the job.

Scan-and-go with Knox Capture
With Knox Capture, your XCover6 Pro can readily become an enterprise-grade barcode scanner. Simply scan as you would take a picture and the captured barcode data are automatically integrated into your business apps.

name: StarTech.com 6 foot (2m) Durable Black USB-C to Lightning Cable - Heavy Duty Rugged Aramid Fiber USB Type C to Lightning Charger/Sync Power Cord - Apple MFi Certified iPad/iPhone 12
description:
Durable USB Type-C to Lightning Cable | Aramid Fiber | EMI Protection | TPE Cable Jacket

This 2 m (6.5 ft.) black USB C to Lightning cable withstands the daily demands of charging and syncing your iPad, iPhone or other mobile devices featuring the Lightning connector. Tested to endure strenuous wear and tear and winter and summer in-car use, the strong and rugged cable is a must-have for both business and consumer applications.

Built for Daily Use

The durable USB C to Lightning cable has aramid fiber reinforcement that shelters it from the stress of frequent bends and twists. This also lets the heavy duty cable flex without over-stretching and strengthens the core of the cable.

Cable Key Features

Aramid fiber adds strength and durability to the cable
• Insulated conductors reduce friction, provide more flexibility
• EMI (electromagnetic interference) protection with aluminum-mylar foil with braided shielding
• TPE (thermoplastic elastomer) cable jacket is softer and more flexible than a standard PVC cable and environmentally friendly

Flexible Strain Relief

The reinforced cable is constructed to prevent the connector from separating from the jacket. The extra-long strain relief molding is tested to withstand over 10,000+ bend cycles at a 180° angle. Plus, the improved inner molding resists cracking and reduces cable damage.

Connector Key Features

Lightning connector provides 12W so your charger can charge your iOS devices
• Metal shield protects circuit board from EMI and reinforces the connection point
• Strain relief tested to tolerate over 10,000+ bend cycles at a 180° angle

RUSBCLTMM2MB is an Apple MFi certified Lightning cable backed by a StarTech.com 2-year warranty.

The StarTech.com Advantage

name: Manhattan USB-C to Lightning Cable, Charge & Sync, 1m, White, For Apple iPhone/iPad/iPod, Male to Male, MFi Certified (Apple approval program), 480 Mbps (USB 2.0), Hi-Speed USB, Lifetime Warranty
description:
USB-C to Apple Lightning Cable, MFi Certified - USB Type-C to Lightning Fast-Charge and Sync Power Cord for iPad and iPhone 12 / 13 and more
The Manhattan USB-C to Lightning Cable lets you charge and sync your iPhone, iPad, iPod or other mobile devices featuring the Lightning interface.

Apple MFi-certified means 100% reliable
Uncertified third-party cables tend to not work properly with Apple Lightning devices. This Manhattan cable is officially licensed and MFi-certified to work flawlessly with any device that uses a Lightning connector. MFi certification means this USB-C to Lightning cable will keep working with your iPhone and iPad as you update it with new firmware.

Ultra-fast charging with Power Delivery
Take advantage of the fast-charge feature on your iPhone 8 or later. Charge it from 0 to 50% in just 30 minutes. This works either with a USB-C Power Delivery charger with 18 W or higher (available from Manhattan) or an 18 to 96 W USB‑C power adapter from Apple.

High-Speed Data Transfer
Transfer movies, music, or an entire photo library quickly with 480 Mbps transfer speeds. Thanks to its certification, the cable links your iOS/iPadOS® device properly to your USB-equipped computer, Mac, charger, hub, dock or other compatible device.

Strong shielding and heavy-duty jacket with flexible strain relief
The extremely durable molded PVC boot and jacket absorb the stress of frequent bends without damaging the core of the cable. They resist cracking and protect the cable from daily wear and tear or frequent in-car use. The double shielding (aluminum foil and braid) and corrosion-resistant contacts provide maximum signal integrity. Both plugs are reversible, so they will always fit, no matter which way you insert them.

Universal compatibility
This Manhattan cable is great for such different devices as the iPhone 12/13 Pro/Max/mini®, iPhone 8/11/11 Pro, iPhone XR, iPad Air®, iPad, iPad mini®, AirPods®, Magic Keyboard® / Magic Trackpad® / Magic Mouse® and Siri Remote®. With an enabled iPad like the iPad Pro® 11-inch (1st generation) or later, you can even use the cable to charge an iPhone from your iPad.

name: Fairphone 4 16 cm (6.3") Dual SIM Android 11 5G USB Type-C 8 GB 256 GB 3905 mAh Green
description:
SUSTAINABLE. LONG-LASTING. FAIR.
Our most sustainable smartphone yet, now with 5G speed, 5-year warranty and electronic waste neutral.

A quality smartphone with fairness at its core
Sustainability has never been this powerful. Designed to last, with fair and recycled materials, the Fairphone 4 brings you 5G speed, with great battery life and a premium dual-camera - all backed by our 5-year warranty.

Love using your phone for longer

Yours to open, yours to keep
You don’t need to be an expert to swap out the battery or display. No part of Fairphone 4 is glued shut, so you can choose to easily repair it yourself with a standard screwdriver.

How your phone is made, matters

Fairtrade Gold, recycled materials
We’re innovating where it counts. With Fairphone 4, we’re pushing ourselves to the next level of fair by introducing even more materials that are responsibly sourced and conflict-free.
The phone’s body is machined from aluminium from certified vendors, with a 100% recycled plastic back cover. We're working behind the scenes to integrate fairer cobalt and lithium into our batteries and we're the only smartphone manufacturer with Fairtrade gold in our supply chain. Try that on for size.
And this is just the beginning of our journey.

Meet the makers
Bridging the gap between you and your technology is what we’re all about.

Your phone and its materials have been handled hundreds of times by hundreds of people all across the world - They're more than an assembly line. They’re the ones that bring it to life.

So with each Fairphone 4 we pay a living wage bonus to the factory workers.

Ready to use, ready for the future

Beautiful display of design
With its immersive 6.3inch Full HD+ display, smooth aluminium body and soft, recycled back cover the Fairphone 4 is a statement of industrial design, boldly unique in its look and feel.

This device is a challenge to the industry to rethink the modern smartphone: True innovation should be about solving problems, rather than creating new ones. This purpose of design shines through in every aspect of the Fairphone 4. It’s what makes it beautiful.

Super fast 5G speed
Video call your friends in HD, stream high-quality music and even download movies on the move. 5G opens up new possibilities.

No rush, get started with your existing SIM card and switch over when you’re ready. Once you do, your Fairphone 4 will keep you 5G-connected throughout Europe. Fairphone 4 even provides the flexibility to use two SIM cards, introducing an e-SIM slot for an additional number.

Android 11, enjoy every moment
With its powerful processor, large amount of expandable storage and great battery life the Fairphone 4 is ready whenever you need it. Our clean version of Android also keeps things intuitive and simple, yet very customisable.

Quick and easy to set up, transfer everything you need from your old phone and your favorite apps from the Google Play Store.

Make it yours to enjoy!

Focusing on what’s important

Dual cameras for the win
The Fairphone 4 dual cameras are the real deal. A pair of premium lenses for all the details or the bigger picture.

Add a light sensor for blazing fast autofocus and top it off with optical image stabilization for uncompromising image quality. And that counts for the buttery smooth 4K video as well, of course.

High-pixel to capture life’s details
The 48MP quality main lens and carefully dialed in image processing make for an intuitive, effortless camera experience. The Fairphone 4 lets you focus on what matters most: Image quality in every frame and setting. Capture true to life colors, in great detail, every time.

Ultrawide to expand your horizons
The best camera is the one you have with you. This one also has a tack-sharp 48MP ultra-wide lens that lives up to its name with an immersive 120° viewing angle. Expand your horizon and get the bigger picture.

Explore your world in high definition
Whether you’re video calling your family, sharing a special moment with your friends or documenting a memorable trip, these cameras’ got your back.

The advanced image stabilization and highly dialed-in image processing give you the freedom to explore and never worry about missing that clip, no matter the scene.

Your life, your memories, your camera
We designed the camera app to give you the freedom to focus on the shot. You can customize it to match your style and have all your favorite features at your fingertips.

No waste, no worries

Fairphone 4 is electronic waste neutral
We go one step further to conserve the precious materials used in manufacturing electronic products. When you buy a Fairphone 4, we responsibly recycle or give one old phone a second life.

This means 100% compensation for the material we put into the market. This is first in the smartphone industry and it’s exactly the kind of dedication you won’t find anywhere else!

description:
3-in-1 USB Charger Cable | Braided | Apple MFi Certified | USB 2.0

This USB multi-charging cable a single-cable solution that makes it easy to charge and sync your Apple Lightning or Android devices.

3-in-1 USB Charging Cable

Keep this USB to Micro-USB, USB-C or Lightning cable on hand for all your charging needs, instead of carrying multiple cables. The 3-in-1 cable makes it easy for you to switch between different device models and platforms. Note that it will only connect to one device at a time.

Charge your devices from a USB wall charger, car charger, or power bank. The longer cable offers a greater range, so you can access your device conveniently even while it’s connected to a charger.

Avoid Kinks and Tangles

With a braided nylon jacket, this durable charging cable doesn’t kink or tangle as easily as non-braided cables do. It’s an excellent replacement for any of your charging cables.

Easy to Use

To charge or sync a USB-C or Lightning mobile device, simply attach the corresponding connector to the Micro-USB connector and plug into your device. To charge or sync a Micro-USB device, plug just the middle connector of the cable into your mobile device.

The cable will only charge or sync one device at a time.

LTCUB1MGR is Apple MFi certified and backed by StarTech.com 2-year warranty to ensure dependable performance.

The StarTech.com Advantage

description:

The Manhattan USB-C to Lightning Cable lets you charge and sync your iPhone, iPad, iPod or other mobile devices featuring the Lightning interface.

Apple MFi-certified means 100% reliable
Uncertified third-party cables tend to not work properly with Apple Lightning devices. This Manhattan cable is officially licensed and MFi-certified to work flawlessly with any device that uses a Lightning connector. MFi certification means this USB-C to Lightning cable will keep working with your iPhone and iPad as you update it with new firmware.

Ultra-fast charging with Power Delivery

Strong shielding and heavy-duty jacket with flexible strain relief
The extremely durable molded PVC boot and jacket absorb the stress of frequent bends without damaging the core of the cable. They resist cracking and protect the cable from daily wear and tear or frequent in-car use. The double shielding (aluminum foil and braid) and corrosion-resistant contacts provide maximum signal integrity. Both plugs are reversible, so they will always fit, no matter which way you insert them.

Universal compatibility
This Manhattan cable is great for such different devices as the iPhone 12/13 Pro/Max/mini®, iPhone 8/11/11 Pro, iPhone XR, iPad Air®, iPad, iPad mini®, AirPods®, Magic Keyboard® / Magic Trackpad® / Magic Mouse® and Siri Remote®. description:
A super-powered Google phone.

The power and brains behind Pixel 8 Pro.
The Google Tensor G3 chip is custom-designed with Google AI for cutting-edge photo and video features and smarter ways to help throughout the day.2 And it makes Pixel 8 Pro super fast and efficient.

Everyday moments through a pro-level lens.

50 MP main camera for even more detail.
The large main sensor with an ƒ/1.68 aperture creates the best low-light photos and videos, with 2x optical-quality zoom for the most stunning close-ups.6

48 MP ultrawide camera for improved Macro Focus.
It's the highest resolution yet from Pixel's ultrawide camera. Zoom in even closer with enhanced Macro Focus. And zoom out even farther for astrophotography.

48 MP telephoto camera is Pixel's best zoom ever.
The dedicated 5x telephoto optical zoom provides the highest quality zoom on Pixel – and up to 30x with Super Res Zoom.2

10.5 MP front camera for your sharpest selfies yet.
With over 95° field of view, the new ultrawide camera has dedicated auto-focus for the sharpest selfies ever on Pixel.

Even more creative control. Even better photos.
Pro controls unlock advanced camera settings like shutter speed, ISO and more.7 And they enable high-resolution images for richer detail.

Better low-light photos. It's like night and day.
The Pixel 8 Pro camera delivers stunning photo quality from dusk until dawn with Night Sight and Astrophotography.

Incredible videos on every take.

Stunning comes standard.
The Pixel Camera records sharp, smooth video with rich colour and clear audio, even in crowded, dimly lit places. Google AI applies noise reduction to boost video quality in any light.8

Expert video processing.

Don't worry about shaky or imperfect videos. Video Boost automatically adjusts colour, lighting, stabilisation and graininess. And it enables Night Sight Video on Pixel 8 Pro.^

Beautifully authentic videos with Real Tone.
Real Tone, now in video, represents more skin tones accurately. So everyone feels seen.

Advanced editing helps you to control every detail.
With Google AI, you can edit photos in ways that you never thought possible, so they match your vision.

Reimagine your photos. Directly on your phone.
Use Magic Editor in Google Photos to add custom edits and studio-quality enhancements to any photo.27 Improve lighting and background, move a subject, and more, with just a few taps.

Video sounds even better.
Audio Magic Eraser uses Google AI to reduce distracting sounds like cars and wind, so you can hear the ones that you want.‡‡

Google AI makes it even easier to search, screen calls, translate and more.

A super easy way to search.
Circle to search anything directly from the app that you're in on Pixel 8 Pro. Just draw a circle around an image, text or video with your finger and Google AI finds it fast.

Pixel 8 Pro is now running Gemini Nano.
Google's most efficient AI model is built for on-device tasks like Summarise in Recorder, so you can read the highlights from your recorded conversations without a network connection.

Translate on the spot.
With Live Translate, you can interpret face-to-face conversations in 49 languages, transcribe messages in real time and translate signs.

Goodbye, spam calls.
With Call Screen, Google Assistant can now detect and filter out even more spam calls. For other calls, it can tell you who's calling and why before you pick up

Temperature readings,
right on your phone.
Get the temperature of an object with your Pixel 8 Pro. Just scan to check a cooking pan, drinks and more.

name: PanzerGlass ® Screen Protector iPhone 15 | Classic Fit
description:
Want to protect your phone screen from the hazards of everyday life? Then this scratch, shock and drop-resistant screen protector from PanzerGlass® is your knight in shining armor. It will keep your screen safe from accidental bumps against sharp-edged dangers in your pocket and crushing falls onto stone-hard pavements. And to top it all off, it even has a smudge-free coating that reduces traces of fingerprints and grease to give you a clear screen view.


The screen protection prolongs the lifetime of your phone so that one day you can pass it on to someone else who will love it just as much as you do. This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: For this screen protector, we have managed to reduce the paper packaging by approximately 30%* compared to previous models. And like all our products, it comes in a box made of recyclable FSC™-certified paper.


Installation is easy. Usually one attempt is enough, and should you need more, don’t worry, the screen protector can be re-fitted up to 200 times. To make it even easier, we’ve included step-by-step instructions as well as a QR code for quick access to our online how-to video. And remember: Once the screen protector is applied, you’ll never again fear the sight of your phone tumbling to the ground screen first. This may not happen, but if it does, you’ll regret not having clicked “add to cart”.


The screen protector is Classic Fit, meaning it covers the active part of your screen. For 360-degree phone protection, combine the screen protection with a PanzerGlass® protective case and PanzerGlass® PicturePerfect camera lens protector.


*Estimated by comparing the paper weight with our 2022 packaging.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 17.3 cm (6.8") Dual SIM 5G USB Type-C 12 GB 512 GB 5000 mAh Titanium, Violet
description:
Live Translate. The easiest way to communicate
Thanks to Live Translate, now you can get real-time interpretation while you're on the phone. Break down language barriers like never before — even through messaging. Reply back in your own language — itll get translated on their end too.

Circle it, find it. Just like that
A new way to search is here with Circle to Search. Stumble upon a photo of a plant so beautiful that you just have to know what it is? Circle it with your S Pen or finger and ta-da, you'll get Google Search results. Now you can quickly get an answer without leaving your feed.

Summarise Notes in the blink of an AI
Whether you're typing up a storm or jotting something down, Note Assist makes a long story short. Simply start writing, and format it into a clear, easy-to-review summary later. And when you're looking for an old note, the new covers show simple summaries — keeping your screen looking organised.

Resize it, Retouch it. Just like that
Something out of place? Just move it in post. New AI-powered editing options let you get the photo you wanted, like relocating objects and intelligently filling in the space they left behind.

Armour up with titanium
Check out the upgrade — a durable shield of titanium built right into the frame. Corning® Gorilla® Armour helps protect your screen from scratches to keep your device looking beautiful. And don't let water dampen your spirits. Galaxy S24 Ultra is IP68 water and dust resistant.

Built-in S Pen writes a whole new chapter
The legacy of Galaxy Note is alive and well. Write, tap and navigate with precision your fingers wish they had on the new, flat display.

200MP. Capture details that rival reality
With the most megapixels on a smartphone and AI processing, Galaxy S24 Ultra sets the industry standard for image quality every time you hit the shutter. What's more, the new ProVisual engine recognises objects — improving colour tone, reducing noise and bringing out detail.

Our most powerful Quad Tele zoom yet
Dont let long distance get you down. Now you can get 2x, 3x, 5x and even 10x close-ups with optical or optical quality zoom. Plus, the new, powerful Tele OIS is wider than before to stabilise the shot for less zoom-in blur.

ProVisual engine shoots every night in clear detail
Space Zoom puts you in the middle of the action, even at night. With 1.6x larger pixels and a wider Tele OIS, photos and videos are brighter and more stable — making even distant subjects clearly stunning.

Our most hyper-realistic mobile gameplay yet
Victory can be yours with Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy. Faster processing gives you the power you need for all the gameplay you want. Manifest hyper-realistic shadows and reflections with ray tracing. Then get improved performance and heat dissipation with a Vapor Chamber nearly doubled in size.

All-day battery to play on and on
With massive capacity and greater energy efficiency, Ultra's battery gives you extra life when it matters most — you know, like the epic boss battle you've been gearing up for.

2600 nit display. Our brightest adaptive mobile display under the sun
Our most immersive display comes with some major visibility upgrades. Corning® Gorilla® Armour reduces reflections and improves visual clarity, even in direct sunlight. Then, an improved Vision Booster enhances contrast and colour for a clearly exceptional experience.

Quick Share outside your ecosystem
You're not limited to Galaxy phones. Use QR codes and saved contacts to share with iOS users or far-away friends and family.

Switch effortlessly from iOS
Keep your photos, videos, contacts, calendar and apps with Smart Switch — even if you switch from iOS.

Get quick language translation on your next phone call. That's right, AI helps you communicate outside your own language while you talk on the phone. And get this, it even works on messaging.

Circle it, find it. Just like that
Search like never before with Circle to Search. Simply trace an object to get Google Search results. Its a new visual way to find what you're looking for.

AI can summarise your voice recordings
Ready for your own personal assistant? Record your voice and AI will jot it down — convert it into text, then intelligently summarise it. It even does language translations.

Resize it, Retouch it. Just like that
Unlock the magic of AI-powered photo editing. Now you can effortlessly perfect your photos, ensuring every image shines. But that's not all, even if you can't capture the shot you want, Generative Edit can fill in backgrounds and make unwanted objects disappear.

Big, bigger and faster
They're the upgrades you've been waiting for. More screen size, more battery life, more processing power. Theres so much more to love about Galaxy S24 and S24+. And Galaxy S24+ comes with the highest screen resolution on a Galaxy device: QHD+.

Get the details on Camera
Whether you're snapping a super sweet selfie, shooting wide angle pics or zooming in, these cameras will help ensure you leave with a pixel-perfect shot.

50MP. Mega Mega Pixels
A true pixel powerhouse that will not disappoint. Ever. Snap high-res pics for that will no doubt withstand the test of time for years to come.

Shoot far. Even in the dark
Capture bright, colourful, clear photos, even in the dark with AI ISP. Finally, the portraits you've been dreaming of. Zoom in 2x, or even 3x — it doesn't really matter. Each distance can be as clear as day even though it's technically night.

Get closer with every pinch
Just keep pinching. Go from 1x to 2x or even 3x. AI keeps pictures high-quality: crisp, clear and super sharp — without losing much detail.

Stronger Vapor Chamber. Game on
'This new and improved heat dissipation system helps you keep gaming at optimal performance. Our latest Vapor Chamber is bigger than before, with an integrated liquid-type thermal interface material.

The all-day battery is smarter for longer
Power on. And on. And on. Galaxy S24 and S24+ have an intelligent battery that gives you more game time, watch time and you time.

Our brightest adaptive mobile display under the sun
Level up your game with these two massive screens. With increased display size and ultra-slim bezels, Galaxy S24's 6.2" FHD+ display and Galaxy S24+'s 6.7" QHD+ display offer more screen real estate than ever before. Plus, enjoy optimal colour and contrast with Vision Booster on both displays.

Quick Share outside your ecosystem
You're not limited to Galaxy phones. Use QR codes and saved contacts to share with iOS users or far-away friends and family.

Switch effortlessly from iOS

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 17.3 cm (6.8") Dual SIM 5G USB Type-C 12 GB 256 GB 5000 mAh Titanium, Yellow
description:
Live Translate. The easiest way to communicate
Thanks to Live Translate, now you can get real-time interpretation while you're on the phone. Break down language barriers like never before — even through messaging. Reply back in your own language — itll get translated on their end too.

Circle it, find it. Just like that
A new way to search is here with Circle to Search. Stumble upon a photo of a plant so beautiful that you just have to know what it is? Circle it with your S Pen or finger and ta-da, you'll get Google Search results. Now you can quickly get an answer without leaving your feed.

Summarise Notes in the blink of an AI
Whether you're typing up a storm or jotting something down, Note Assist makes a long story short. Simply start writing, and format it into a clear, easy-to-review summary later. And when you're looking for an old note, the new covers show simple summaries — keeping your screen looking organised.

Resize it, Retouch it. Just like that
Something out of place? Just move it in post. New AI-powered editing options let you get the photo you wanted, like relocating objects and intelligently filling in the space they left behind.

Armour up with titanium
Check out the upgrade — a durable shield of titanium built right into the frame. Corning® Gorilla® Armour helps protect your screen from scratches to keep your device looking beautiful. And don't let water dampen your spirits. Galaxy S24 Ultra is IP68 water and dust resistant.

Built-in S Pen writes a whole new chapter
The legacy of Galaxy Note is alive and well. Write, tap and navigate with precision your fingers wish they had on the new, flat display.

200MP. Capture details that rival reality
With the most megapixels on a smartphone and AI processing, Galaxy S24 Ultra sets the industry standard for image quality every time you hit the shutter. What's more, the new ProVisual engine recognises objects — improving colour tone, reducing noise and bringing out detail.

Our most powerful Quad Tele zoom yet
Dont let long distance get you down. Now you can get 2x, 3x, 5x and even 10x close-ups with optical or optical quality zoom. Plus, the new, powerful Tele OIS is wider than before to stabilise the shot for less zoom-in blur.

ProVisual engine shoots every night in clear detail
Space Zoom puts you in the middle of the action, even at night. With 1.6x larger pixels and a wider Tele OIS, photos and videos are brighter and more stable — making even distant subjects clearly stunning.

Our most hyper-realistic mobile gameplay yet
Victory can be yours with Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy. Faster processing gives you the power you need for all the gameplay you want. Manifest hyper-realistic shadows and reflections with ray tracing. Then get improved performance and heat dissipation with a Vapor Chamber nearly doubled in size.

All-day battery to play on and on
With massive capacity and greater energy efficiency, Ultra's battery gives you extra life when it matters most — you know, like the epic boss battle you've been gearing up for.

2600 nit display. Our brightest adaptive mobile display under the sun
Our most immersive display comes with some major visibility upgrades. Corning® Gorilla® Armour reduces reflections and improves visual clarity, even in direct sunlight. Then, an improved Vision Booster enhances contrast and colour for a clearly exceptional experience.

Quick Share outside your ecosystem
You're not limited to Galaxy phones. Use QR codes and saved contacts to share with iOS users or far-away friends and family.

Switch effortlessly from iOS
Keep your photos, videos, contacts, calendar and apps with Smart Switch — even if you switch from iOS.

name: Ocushield Anti Blue Light Screen Protector Anti-glare screen protector Apple 1 pc(s)
description:
BLUE LIGHT SHIELD FOR IPHONES
What’s that all about?
Blue light is a segment of the visible light spectrum responsible for keeping you alert. It’s naturally present in sunlight, but is also concentrated in the light that comes out of your digital devices — phones, tablets, laptops, everything! And that’s not a good thing.

Blue light, it's a modern day menace
Blue light penetrates your retinas, giving your brain a morning cue that it’s time to wake up and seize the day. But extended exposure to blue light can have a significant impact on our wellbeing — headaches, eye irritation and fatigue are all common symptoms of blue light exposure.

Plus, by restricting the production of melatonin (a chemical which helps us sleep), blue light disrupts your natural sleep cycle causing you to feel lethargic, irritable and unproductive. You may be excited about buying that iPhone 13 or 14 Pro Max, but yikes!

That’s why we created blue light screen protectors for iPhone
Ocushield blue light filters block harmful blue light before it reaches your eyes. This keeps your eyes feeling fresh, diminishing dryness and enabling longer periods of focus.

Developed by qualified optometrists, our MHRA & FDA registered anti blue light filters block up to 99% of harmful UV and blue light emissions between 300-400nm, and up to 54% of harmful blue light between 400-470nm.

By reducing your exposure to blue light in the evenings, Ocushield blue light filters will help you get to sleep peacefully and boost the quality of your sleep, and let your worries about blue light slip away.

5x stronger protection than the competition.
The Ocushield® tempered glass screen protector is five times stronger versus other screen protectors on the market, and guards your phone screen from cracks when you drop it, offering you shock absorbant security that protects your phone from damage.

Our premium screen protector is super thin to boost display quality, and is made from reinforced 9H tempered glass, equivalent to alumnicatine, better known as gorilla glass. Our protectors are compatible with all iPhone screens, including the iPhone XR, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14 ranges.

Ocushield® offers both your eyes and your phone unrivalled protection when using your technology. Oil resistant and anti reflection coating stops pesky fingerprint marks as well as glare from interrupting a perfect display.

Recommended by professionals

Ocushield® is recommended by leading Eye Doctor Joseph Allen - also known as Dr Eye Health.

He recommends Ocushield® as his favourite blue filter on the market to prevent harmful blue light from screens entering your eyes.

What’s in the blue light iphone screen protector package?
- Anti-blue light screen protector (tempered glass, won’t affect screen colours)
- Micro fibre cloth + dust removers
- Easy applicator tray
- Full instructions

description:

This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: For this case, we have managed to reduce the paper packaging by approximately 30%* compared to previous models. And like all our products, it comes in a recyclable FSC™-certified box. 


Installation is easy. Just click on the case and you can breathe freely, knowing that you’ll never again fear the terrifying sight of your phone tumbling to the ground. This may not happen, but if it does, you’ll regret not having clicked “add to cart”. And remember: If you want to take extra good care of your phone, you can combine the Soft TPU Case with a SAFE. by PanzerGlassTM screen protector and a PanzerGlass® PicturePerfect camera lens protector. 


*Estimated by comparing the paper weight with our 2022 packaging.

Thanks to Live Translate, now you can get real-time interpretation while you're on the phone. Break down language barriers like never before — even through messaging. Reply back in your own language — it’ll get translated on their end too.

Pick the right tone for your text with Chat Assist
Compose text messages with AI at the helm in Chat Assist. Now you can say what you mean with the voice of a professional, a close friend, even just politely. Go from ”how do I say this?” to ”why didn't I think of that?” in seconds.

Summarise Notes in the blink of an AI
Whether you're typing up a storm or jotting something down, Note Assist makes a long story short. Simply start writing, and format it into a clear, easy-to-review summary later.

Our most hyper-realistic mobile gameplay yet
Victory can be yours with the new Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy. Faster processing gives you the power you need for all the gameplay you want. Then, manifest graphic effects in real time with ray tracing for hyper-realistic shadows and reflections.
And guess what? We've nearly doubled the size of Galaxy S24 Ultra's Vapour Chamber to improve heat dissipation and give you the smooth graphics experience as it was intended.

Long-lasting battery to play on and on
With massive capacity and greater energy efficiency, Ultra's battery gives you extra life when it matters most — you know, like the epic boss battle you've been gearing up for.

2600 nit display. Our brightest adaptive mobile display under the sun
Our most immersive display comes with some major visibility upgrades. Corning Gorilla Armour reduces reflections and improves visual clarity, even in direct sunlight. Then, an improved Vision Booster enhances contrast and colour for a clearly exceptional experience.

Quick Share outside your ecosystem
You're not limited to Galaxy phones. Use QR codes and saved contacts to share with iOS users or far-away friends and family.

Secured by Knox Matrix
Rest easy with our unparalleled mobile protection, fortified by Knox Matrix with multi-device security. Your data, privacy and peace of mind are our top priority.

Google Pixel 9 Pro XL 17.3 cm (6.8"), 16 GB, 512 GB, 50 MP, Android 14, Obsidian
description:
All pro.
Pure magic.
It's the most powerful Pixel yet with Gemini, your built-in AI assistant.

Beautifully designed.
The Pixel 9 Pro's elevated new design has a silky matt glass back, beautiful dual-finish camera bar and polished-finish metal frame that feels as good as it looks.

Highly acclaimed camera. Pro-level photos.
The Pixel 9 Pro triple rear camera system gives you super-close closeups, sharp selfies and rich colours – even in low light.

50 MP main camera for incredible image quality.
Take amazing low-light photos and stunning closeups with the ƒ/1.68 aperture and 2x optical quality.

48 MP telephoto for pro-level zoom.
The dedicated 5x telephoto lens enables 10x optical quality, and can go up to 30x with Super Res Zoom.

48 MP ultrawide for Pixel's best Macro Focus.
Get up close, and even closer with Macro Focus. You can also zoom way out super wide for astrophotography.

42 MP front camera for super-sharp selfies.
Super wide 103° field of view, dedicated autofocus, and 30% better low-light performance

Videos that move you.
A first for video zoom.
Pixel 9 Pro combines a powerful telephoto lens with advanced video processing to give you smooth, high-quality video up to 20x with Super Res Zoom Video

Amazing video after dark.
Night Sight Video takes sharp videos in low-light situations like restaurants and night-time skylines. So that you see rich detail and colour, even when it's dark.

Cutting-edge 8K video.
Video Boost enhances your video up to 8K resolution. It improves colour, lighting and stabilisation for the best quality video ever on Pixel.

Control your camera like a pro.
Bring your vision to life with advanced camera settings like shutter speed, manual focus and more. The camera also supports full-resolution images.

The camera that makes you feel seen.
True-to-you skin tones.
Real Tone represents the nuances of skin tones beautifully, authentically and accurately in photos and video.

Selfies for everyone.
Guided Frame helps people with low vision take the best selfies. It uses audio and haptics to guide a face right into frame.

Work your magic.
Add your own creative vision to your photos with Pixel 9 Pro's advanced editing and AI tools.

Take a picture. And be in it, too.
Add Me makes sure that no one is left out of a photo. Take one with the group, then swap in the photographer. Pixel magically merges both photos

Group pics that the whole group loves.
Get an amazing group photo by combining similar photos. Pixel finds the best moment, or you can choose everyone's best expression

Zoom. Snap. Zoom some more.
Zoom Enhance helps you get even closer, even after you've zoomed in. AI enhances details and quality, so that the photo looks sharp.

The cure for blur.
Photo Unblur in Google Photos sharpens your fuzzy pics – new or old – in just a few taps.

Reimagine your photos, just like that.
Magic Editor in Google Photos makes advanced photo editing easy with AI and a few taps.

A perfect way to frame it.
Magic Editor can suggest the best crop and reframe your photo. It even expands your image to get more of the scene.

Move whatever, wherever.
Move people or objects anywhere in the frame to make your photos match your vision.

Make distractions disappear.
Get rid of objects, photobombers and other things that you don't want in your picture.

Reimagine the scenery.
Reimagine the scenery just by typing what you want to see, like turn a wall into a bridge or fill the sky with pink balloons.

Pretty much everything.
Now easier.
Use AI to supercharge your ideas, easily search and organise info, and jumpstart your creativity. With just a few taps.

Gemini. Your built-in AI assistant.
Find answers IRL.
Take a photo, and chat with Gemini to get help and ideas, like making a recipe from a picture of what's in your fridge

Get it done on the spot.
Chat with Gemini to get more info quickly – like taking a list of restaurants and making a map of where to find them

Catch up quick.
Gemini can summarise your Google Docs and unread messages in Gmail.

Pixel remembers. So that you don't have to.
Pixel Screenshots helps you save info that you want to remember later – like events, places and more – and uses Gemini to find what you need, right when you need it.

Circle to Search. Whoa!
Circle an image or text, even in a video. Google AI finds it fast – right from the app that you're in.

The power behind Pro.
The brightest Pixel display ever.
The Super Actua display is bright and vivid, even in sunlight. It runs up to 120 Hz for smooth gaming and scrolling.

The fastest, pro-est performance.
The new Google Tensor G4 chip and 16 GB RAM power Google's most advanced AI on Pixel 9 Pro.

Charges fast and lasts all day.
The battery lasts over 24 hours – and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.18 And Pixel 9 Pro XL can charge to 70% in about 30 minutes.

Pixel gets the latest AI features first.
Pixel Drops keep your Pixel 9 Pro fresh, with the latest Google AI, camera features, helpful tools and more.20 Plus, your phone comes with seven years of OS and security updates.

name: PanzerGlass SAFE. by ® Screen Protector iPhone 16 Pro Max | Ultra-Wide Fit
description:
SAFE. is for real. SAFE. is for you. SAFE. is for dance floor mishaps, selfies gone wrong and your everyday fumbling, dropping and screen cracking. This SAFE. by PanzerGlass®️ screen protector made of 60% recycled material acts as a discrete airbag, protecting your phone by absorbing impacts and providing high-level scratch resistance without compromising the functionality and look of your device. It even has a smudge-free coating that reduces traces of fingerprints and grease.


Can you feel it? Love is in the air. Love for phones and the planet. It’s the new circle of phone life. When you keep your beloved phone SAFE., you can one day pass it on to another phone lover who will love it just as much as you do. Choose SAFE. and give your phone a second, third or fourth life! This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future! Another is to use less and less and LESS packaging: For this screen protector, we’ve reduced the paper packaging by 33%*. And like all our products, it comes in a recyclable FSC™-certified box.


Everybody deserves to be SAFE. Without hassle, red tape, or unnecessary complexity. This screen protector comes with an EasyAligner that makes installation a piece of cake (seriously!) and to make it even easier, we’ve included step-by-step instructions as well as a QR code for quick access to our online how-to video. And remember: You just need to install the screen protection once! Then you’ll never again fear the sight of your phone tumbling to the ground screen first. This may not happen, but if it does, you’ll regret not having clicked “add to cart”.


No screen protection is worth poor screen performance! That’s why this screen protector comes in Ultra-Wide Fit, meaning it covers the front surface of your phone, providing a complete and crystal-clear view of your screen. It even leaves a little room around the edges to give you the freedom to upgrade your protection with a SAFE. by PanzerGlassTM case. And if you want 360-degree protection, combine the screen protector and case with a SAFE. by PanzerGlass® camera lens protector.


Keep your phone SAFE.


*Measured by third-party lab by comparing the mass of the new paper packaging introduced in 2023 with the mass of the previous paper packaging introduced in 2022 (CPRTC, report No. ZSA20231301-0016).

name: Apple Beats iPhone 16 Case with MagSafe - Summit Stone
description:
Built to protect your iPhone from scratches and drops, the Beats iPhone Case with MagSafe has undergone thousands of hours of testing throughout the design and manufacturing process. It is precisely crafted to fit the design and buttons on iPhone 16.

This case works seamlessly with Camera Control. It features a sapphire crystal, coupled to a conductive layer to communicate finger movements to the Camera Control.

The hardshell polycarbonate back is complemented by flexible sidewalls to optimize shock absorption, while making the case thin, light, and easy to grip. The exterior is treated with a glossy, scratch-resistant coating for extra protection, and the soft microfiber lining gently reduces surface scratches and abrasion.

Compatible with MagSafe, this case has built-in magnets that align perfectly with iPhone 16 for an easy attach experience and efficient wireless charging.

Made with post-consumer recycled materials, the Beats iPhone Case with MagSafe is available in four stylish colorways complemented by bold interior accent colors. The packaging is 100 percent fiber based, and the wood fibers are 100 percent recycled and responsibly sourced.

Built to protect your iPhone from scratches and drops, the Beats iPhone Case with MagSafe has undergone thousands of hours of testing throughout the design and manufacturing process. It is precisely crafted to fit the design and buttons on iPhone 16 Plus.

This case works seamlessly with Camera Control. It features a sapphire crystal, coupled to a conductive layer to communicate finger movements to the Camera Control.

The hardshell polycarbonate back is complemented by flexible sidewalls to optimize shock absorption, while making the case thin, light, and easy to grip. The exterior is treated with a glossy, scratch-resistant coating for extra protection, and the soft microfiber lining gently reduces surface scratches and abrasion.

Compatible with MagSafe, this case has built-in magnets that align perfectly with iPhone 16 Plus for an easy attach experience and efficient wireless charging.

Made with post-consumer recycled materials, the Beats iPhone Case with MagSafe is available in four stylish colorways complemented by bold interior accent colors. The packaging is 100 percent fiber based, and the wood fibers are 100 percent recycled and responsibly sourced.

DEFENDER SERIES FOR MAGSAFE | RUGGED PROTECTION
Defender Series for MagSafe has rugged drop protection with 7 times as many drops as military standard (MIL-STD-810G 516.6). Features include wireless charging compatibility; port covers to block dirt; a convenient holster that works as a belt clip and a hands-free kickstand for ultimate productivity. Precision designed opening for easy interaction with Camera Control without compromising on protection.

OUR MAGSAFE ECOSYSTEM
An OtterBox MagSafe compatible case not only protects your iPhone from drops and scratches, it also unlocks a whole host of possibilities for your MagSafe-compatible iPhone. Swap, attach and go with the OtterBox MagSafe range – whether you need a MagSafe Charging Stand to power-up your device, a MagSafe Car Mount to keep your iPhone hands-free while on the go, or a MagSafe Wallet to carry your essentials – OtterBox has you covered.

Why Choose no Retail Packaging?
No Retail Packaging represents OtterBox´s pledge to reducing packaging waste. Choose these streamlined, time-saving packaging options and help us move closer to a more sustainable future. Our logo on the No Retail Packaging sleeve ensures that you´re receiving OtterBox Products.

name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe - Lake Green
description:
Designed by Apple to complement iPhone 16 Pro, the Silicone Case with MagSafe is a delightful way to protect your iPhone.

Made with a 55 percent recycled silicone material, the case has a silky, soft-touch finish on the exterior that feels great in your hand. And on the inside, there’s a soft microfiber lining for even more protection.

This case works seamlessly with Camera Control. It features a sapphire crystal, coupled to a conductive layer to communicate finger movements to the Camera Control.

With built-in magnets that align perfectly with iPhone 16 Pro, this case offers a magical attach experience and faster wireless charging, every time. When it’s time to charge, just leave the case on your iPhone and snap on your MagSafe charger, or set it on your Qi2 or Qi-certified charger.

Like every Apple-designed case, it undergoes thousands of hours of testing throughout the design and manufacturing process. So not only does it look great, it’s built to protect your iPhone from scratches and drops.

name: PanzerGlass SAFE. by ® TPU Case Transparent iPhone 16 Pro Max
description:
Protect your phone from pocket plunges, backseat bumps and freaky Friday-night falls with the Soft TPU Case from SAFE. by PanzerGlass®️. The thin, sleek and transparent case is made of 100% recycled plastic and shields your phone effectively while giving you full access to all of its functions. It is wireless charging compatible and anti-yellowing, ensuring that your case will continue to look good, day after day – even when exposed to sunlight and beach parties.  


The Soft TPU Case protects and prolongs the lifetime of your phone so that one day you can pass it on to someone else who will love it just as much as you do. This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: For this case, we have managed to reduce the paper packaging by approximately 30%* compared to previous models. And like all our products, it comes in a recyclable FSC™-certified box.  


Installation is easy. Just click on the case and you can breathe freely, knowing that you’ll never again fear the terrifying sight of your phone tumbling to the ground. This may not happen, but if it does, you’ll regret not having clicked “add to cart”. And remember: If you want to take extra good care of your phone, you can combine the case with a screen protector and a camera lens protector from SAFE. by PanzerGlass®.  


*Measured by third-party lab by comparing the mass of the new paper packaging introduced in 2023 with the mass of the previous paper packaging introduced in 2022 (CPRTC, report No. ZSA20231301-0016).

name: HMD Fusion Business Edition - 5G, 8GB/256GB, 6,56", 108MP/50MP, 5.000 mAh, Noir
description:
HMD Fusion

Here’s the tea.

One phone, multiple identities
Restyle, revamp, and unlock new functionalities with Fusion Outfits¹ like wireless charging support, a ring light for your pictures, or rugged protection. Best of all, the toolkit for making Smart Outfits is open-source, so who knows what else the innovators out there will come up with.

Smartphone plus Smart Outfits. Genius.
We’re not just talking about fancy cases here. HMD Fusion hooks up to Smart Outfits with a two-way connector. That’s what enables you to control the Flashy Outfit’s light from your phone; it’s what enables the Gaming Outfit’s buttons to work in real-time; it’s what connects the Wireless Charging Outfit to the phone’s battery. Two things coming together for something greater: that’s HMD Fusion.

Don’t put up with a cracked screen
We were going to flatter you with terms like “DIY pro” and such, but truth be told… it really doesn’t take a pro to replace the screen on HMD Fusion. Pop it open, switch it out, and put it back together.

Get ready to turn heads
HMD Fusion is quite the looker, even in its standard, see-through outfit. It’s serving you an ultra-slim body and a raw, no-frills aesthetic. Elegant and industrial. So, when you don’t need any extra functionalities, you can enjoy the au naturel look.

Give it your best shot
Both front and rear cameras are packed with features to get the best out of every snap. The 50 MP selfie camera opens new possibilities with Selfie Gestures and Selfie slo-mo. Around the back, the 108 MP camera is ready for low light, high speeds, and most things in between.

Build your own Smart Outfits
A barcode scanner, a payment terminal, a means to show off your own artwork… HMD Fusion could pretty much be what you want it to be. That’s because, with technical know-how and a 3D printer, you can build your own Smart Outfits. You’ll need the CAD file, and if you’re building something with functionality, the API. Get them both from the HMD Fusion toolkit.

description:

The peace-and-quiet button

name: Google Pixel 9 Pro Fold 20.3 cm (8") Dual SIM Android 14 5G USB Type-C 16 GB 256 GB 4650 mAh Black
description:
An epic display of Google AI.
All the magic of Gemini on Pixel's largest screen.

Slim, sophisticated and super durable.
Google's thinnest foldable features silky matte glass, a redesigned camera bar, and a scratch-resistant display.

Big, beautiful displays. Inside and out.
Immerse yourself in whatever you're doing with the 80% brighter 8" Super Actua Flex inner display and 6.3" Actua outer display.

Do almost anything, like it's nothing.
Search, save and organise info, simplify complex projects and kickstart your creativity. Effortlessly.

Talk things out live.
Instead of typing, go live with Gemini to chat naturally back and forth. It follows along, even if you change your thoughts or – oops – interrupt.

Find answers IRL.
Want to know more about something IRL? Take a photo and chat with Gemini to get help and ideas, like making a recipe from what's in your fridge.

Get inspired. Or just get it done.
Chat with Gemini to brainstorm ideas, get more info and do big tasks like taking a list of restaurants and making a map of where to find them.

Catch up quick.
Avoid inbox backlog with the help of Gemini. Just ask and Gemini will summarise unread messages in your Gmail.

Remembers the details, so that you don't have to.
Can't recall info from a message or an image that you saved? Just ask and Pixel Screenshots searches your saved items to find it for you, quickly.

Circle to Search. Whoa!
Just draw a circle around an image or text, even in a video, to find it fast – directly from the app that you're in.

Divide. And conquer.
With Split Screen, open and use two apps side by side to seamlessly multitask and get more done throughout your day.

Drag, drop, done.
Just drag and drop images, videos, links and text from one app to another. It's a super-fast and easy way to share.

A more natural way to translate.
Google Translate makes face-to-face conversations in different languages even easier. With Dual Screen support, translations appear on the inside and outside screens.

Stunning photos and videos, unfolding in new ways.
With an advanced triple rear camera system, flexible design and innovative AI, it's easy to snap brilliant selfies and incredible group pics, and add custom edits.

Crisp, sharp close-ups.
With a dedicated 5x telephoto lens, get up to 20x Super Res Zoom, and reveal spectacular detail in even the smallest subjects.

Dramatic wide-angle images.
Zoom way out to capture more of the landscape. Zoom way in to see tiny details with crisp clarity. All thanks to the 10.5 MP Ultrawide lens, now with Macro Focus.

Vibrant low-light photos.
Create vivid photos of everything from city lights to starry skies with the 48 MP main wide lens and super fast ƒ/1.7 aperture.

Boost your selfie confidence.
Snap stunning, perfectly framed selfies using the powerful rear camera and the front-screen preview.

Let them see it before you snap it
The Pixel 9 Pro Fold makes it easy to capture everyone looking their best. While you set up the photo, they preview it on the outer screen, posing just right.

A fun way to get them focused.
Get great pics of kids with Made You Look. While you frame the photo, they see fun images that’ll get them looking right at the camera.

Stands and delivers for hands-free pics.
Set it up in tabletop mode for group, Time Lapse or Astro photos. Just set the timer and jump in or say 'Hey Google, take a photo'.

Photographers, welcome to the photo.
Don't just take the photo, be in it too. Add Me lets you add yourself to a photo after you take it, with just a few taps.

Group pics that the whole group loves.
Did someone blink or look away? Best Take lets you combine similar photos to get one amazing group pic.

Add more photo to your photos.
Auto frame in Magic Editor fixes crooked or over-cropped photos. Advanced AI recreates areas around the image, so that you can reframe it as you like.

Set the scene right from your screen.
Want to turn that wall into a bridge or fill the sky with pink balloons? Just type what you want to see and Magic Editor makes it happen.

Big-screen entertainment from anywhere.
Whether you're at home or on the go, feel like you're part of the action with the immersive, impressive 8" inner display.

The perfect setup for hands‑free viewing.
Set your Pixel 9 Pro Fold on a surface in tabletop mode for an easy, convenient way to watch your favourites.

Multitask without missing a thing.
Watch, chat and browse at the same time with Split Screen. Stream on one side. Do something else on the other.

Breaks all kinds of speed limits.
With Pixel's fastest, most powerful chip yet and 16 GB of RAM, Pixel 9 Pro Fold is super quick and efficient, seamlessly delivering cutting-edge AI features.

Get the best of Google AI first.
With regular updates, Pixel brings you the latest features powered by Google AI before other phones. And it comes with seven years of OS and security updates.

name: HMD Fusion - 5G, 4GB/128GB, 6,56", 108MP/50MP, 5.000 mAh, Noir
description:
HMD Fusion

Here’s the tea.

One phone, multiple identities
Restyle, revamp, and unlock new functionalities with Fusion Outfits¹ like wireless charging support, a ring light for your pictures, or rugged protection. Best of all, the toolkit for making Smart Outfits is open-source, so who knows what else the innovators out there will come up with.

Smartphone plus Smart Outfits. Genius.
We’re not just talking about fancy cases here. HMD Fusion hooks up to Smart Outfits with a two-way connector. That’s what enables you to control the Flashy Outfit’s light from your phone; it’s what enables the Gaming Outfit’s buttons to work in real-time; it’s what connects the Wireless Charging Outfit to the phone’s battery. Two things coming together for something greater: that’s HMD Fusion.

Don’t put up with a cracked screen
We were going to flatter you with terms like “DIY pro” and such, but truth be told… it really doesn’t take a pro to replace the screen on HMD Fusion. Pop it open, switch it out, and put it back together.

Get ready to turn heads
HMD Fusion is quite the looker, even in its standard, see-through outfit. It’s serving you an ultra-slim body and a raw, no-frills aesthetic. Elegant and industrial. So, when you don’t need any extra functionalities, you can enjoy the au naturel look.

Give it your best shot
Both front and rear cameras are packed with features to get the best out of every snap. The 50 MP selfie camera opens new possibilities with Selfie Gestures and Selfie slo-mo. Around the back, the 108 MP camera is ready for low light, high speeds, and most things in between.

Build your own Smart Outfits
A barcode scanner, a payment terminal, a means to show off your own artwork… HMD Fusion could pretty much be what you want it to be. That’s because, with technical know-how and a 3D printer, you can build your own Smart Outfits. You’ll need the CAD file, and if you’re building something with functionality, the API. Get them both from the HMD Fusion toolkit.

description:

Meet Galaxy S22, a smartphone designed for creators who want to capture every moment. It’s packed with next-level innovations you didn’t even know were possible. This is a game-changing device that can create breath-taking
low-light videos to make every day - and night - even more epic. But that’s not all. Stay entertained on an incredibly bright Dynamic AMOLED 2X display even in bright sunlight. With more of what you want, you can do more of what you love.

Expression is tough… and colourful
Galaxy S22 has a sleek yet sturdy Armour Aluminium frame that offers tougher drop and scratch resistance to previous generation materials. Its front is equipped with tough Gorilla® Glass Victus+ for an expansive, balanced display. What’s more, Galaxy S22 comes in 4 stunning colours - Phantom Black, Phantom White, Green and Pink Gold.

Say goodbye to glare
Galaxy S22 brings an incredible viewing experience to match your ultimate video device. It boasts a 6.1" Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with unbelievable brightness. You’ll be able to binge-watch your latest boxset in the park without the sunlight spoiling your view. But it doesn’t stop there. With a 24Hz - 120Hz Adaptive Refresh Rate, scrolling through smoother.

Introducing Nightography
Capture and share epically bright night-time videos and portraits with revolutionary, AI-enhanced cameras. Get your best night shots using the revolutionary Nightography feature, giving you unbelievably bright, blur-free videos. When it comes to stills, the 50MP wide camera automatically adjusts exposure, the wider Optical Image Stabilisation (OIS) keeps your shot steady, and Adaptive Pixel technology uses the Wide lens to combine two results to capture the brightest, clearest, most detailed photos on a Galaxy.

Full stream ahead - fastest Galaxy chip

Mighty, long-lasting battery power

A whole new world of video calling

description:

Great features including ClearSound, Assistance button, TeamViewer and our easy to use interface make Doro 8200 the perfect choice for seniors who want to stay connected with family and friends. name: Samsung Galaxy S25 15.8 cm (6.2") Dual SIM Android 15 5G USB Type-C 12 GB 512 GB 4000 mAh Silver
description:
Simple. Impactful
Meet Galaxy S25 and S25+. A sleek, premium design wrapped in a strong aluminium frame with an immersive screen, sophisticated camera and now slimmed down for a more comfortable grip.

Looks sleek, built tough
Wrapped in a light aluminium frame, strengthened with Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus® 2 display glass and rated with IP68 for moisture and dust resistance, Galaxy S25 and S25+ are designed to be taken virtually anywhere.

Personalised briefings for your day
Get personalised briefings throughout the day from the all-new Now Brief. Start your morning with a run-down of the day ahead, such as checking your latest Energy Score and reminders of a busy schedule. Then, recap on the day's events in the evening with daily activity insights.

A sound studio at your fingertips
Easily get rid of unwanted background noise from your videos and make them share-worthy with Audio Eraser. Fine-tune your audio by adjusting different types of sound including voices, music, wind and more.

The future of health, now made personal
Keep up with your health goals by tracking your Energy Score. Sync with Galaxy Watch or Ring and receive personalised insights and coaching such as an analysis of your sleep, activity and heart rate.

Personal data stays personal
The Personal Data Engine combines and processes your primary data and provides tailored suggestions. It encrypts this data and saves it on your device with Knox Vault, making it inaccessible to anyone else. You can even monitor the security of other Galaxy devices right from your Galaxy smartphone.

Unrivaled Nightography video. Less noise, more clarity
Now you can shoot in improved 10-bit HDR for a more stunning videography experience. Our advanced AP also delivers more precise noise removal meaning you won't have to worry about grainy night footage again.

Epic portraits, every single time
We see you. And so does our camera with enhanced Object-aware Engine that can adapt to various lighting environments. Capture skin tones and textures exactly as your eyes see them.

Filters just for you
Bring your pics to life with your own personalised filters. Galaxy AI will analyse your favourite photo and create a filter that captures the scene. Use it instantly or customise further to suit your mood with tweaks to the saturation, brightness and more.

Highlight reels made easy
Effortlessly create reels by collating your videos and simply hitting Auto Trim. AI will detect the key activity and trim them into highlight-ready clips that you can easily modify to your desired length.

The most powerful processor customised for Galaxy
Introducing our most powerful processor, customised for Galaxy. With improved real-time ray tracing and Vulkan optimisation, dive deep into the action with ultra-smooth gameplay thanks to Snapdragon® 8 Elite Mobile Platform for Galaxy.

Unparalleled battery life
Thanks to our pioneering mDNIe technology built into our custom-made AP and software optimisation, Galaxy S25's battery usage time is enhanced for you to enjoy hours of watching videos.

All new One UI 7, built for AI
Get access to your Now Brief alerts, music and more from the Now Bar. The new home screen is all yours with highly-customisable layouts and new widgets. Live notifications let you monitor on-going activities such as voice recordings on the Now Bar, status bar or at the top of your notification panel.

Google Assistant screens your calls and helps avoid spammers. It shows you the best times to call a business and their call menu options. And it even waits on hold for you.

The calls you want sound even better with Clear Calling.
Pixel can filter out your caller’s background noise and enhance their voice, so you can hear them when they’re in a noisy place.

Translate languages in real time.
With Live Translate, you can have face-to-face conversations in 48 languages, chat in real time, and translate menus with your camera.

The battery lasts up to 72 hours and charges wirelessly.
The Adaptive Battery lasts over 24 hours – or up to 3 days with Extreme Battery Saver. And it's easy to charge wirelessly.

Extra online protection at no extra cost.
Pixel uses VPN by Google One to help protect your online activity no matter which app or web browser you use.

Access your phone with a glance or a tap.
Face Unlock or Fingerprint Unlock opens your phone quickly and securely.

Highest-rated security features.
With Google Tensor G2 and the certified Titan M2 security chip, Pixel 7a is built with multiple layers of security to help keep your personal info safe.

Security and privacy settings put you in control.
Pixel makes it easier to protect your phone, accounts, and passwords by showing security and privacy settings in one place. You’ll get at least 5 years of security updates, and you’ll be notified of risks and easy steps to secure your data.

Pixel experiences built for you.
Search your whole phone all at once.
Quickly find apps, messages, photos, and other content in a single search.

See what you need, when you need it.
At a Glance notifies you with the info you need at the right time, like when to leave for a flight, your boarding pass at the airport, and weather alerts.

Your Pixel keeps getting better over time.
Every few months, Pixel gets automatic Feature Drops – new features for the camera, battery, calls, and more. So you don’t have to keep getting a new phone.

name: PanzerGlass ® Screen Protector iPhone 16 | 15 | Classic Fit
description:
Want to protect your phone screen from the hazards of everyday life? Then this scratch, shock and drop-resistant PanzerGlass® screen protector is your knight in shining armor. It’s made of 60% recycled glass and will shield your phone screen from accidental bumps against sharp-edged dangers and crushing falls onto stone-hard pavements. And to top it all off, it has a smudge-free coating that reduces traces of fingerprints and grease to give you a clear screen view. 


The enclosed EasyAligner made of 100% recycled plastic makes installation a piece of cake (seriously!). To make it even easier, we’ve included step-by-step instructions as well as a QR code for quick access to our online how-to video. And remember: Once installed, you’ll never again fear your phone falling screen-first. This might not happen, but then again … it might! 


This screen protection prolongs the lifetime of your phone so that one day you can pass it on to someone else who will love it just as much as you do. It’s the new circle of phone life and one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: In 2024, we reduced the amount of paper in our PanzerGlass® core product packaging design by an average of 66 %*. And of course, we continue to deliver all our products in recyclable FSC™-certified boxes. 


The screen protector is Classic Fit, meaning it covers the active part of your screen. For extra phone protection, combine the screen protection with a PanzerGlass® protective case, for example, a fearlessly fashionable case from CARE by PanzerGlass®, and a PanzerGlass® PicturePerfect or HoopsTM camera lens protector. 


*Reduction from 2022-2024 measured by comparing selected products from the PanzerGlass® core range.

Made with a 55 per cent recycled silicone material, the case has a silky, soft-touch finish on the exterior that feels great in your hand. And on the inside, there’s a soft microfibre lining for even more protection.

With built-in magnets that align perfectly with iPhone 16, this case offers a magical attach experience and faster wireless charging, every time. When it’s time to charge, just leave the case on your iPhone and snap on your MagSafe charger, or set it on your Qi2- or Qi-certified charger.

Like every Apple-designed case, it undergoes thousands of hours of testing throughout the design and manufacturing process. So not only does it look great, it’s built to protect your iPhone from scratches and drops.

name: PanzerGlass ® Privacy Screen Protector iPhone 16 | 15 | Ultra-Wide Fit
description:
Powerful meets privacy! With this PanzerGlass® privacy screen protector made of 60% recycled glass, your personal info is safe from the prying eyes of people sitting next to you on the train, in the coffee shop, or at the office. The specially designed privacy filter renders the content of your screen virtually invisible to everyone except you. It even has a smudge-free coating that reduces traces of fingerprints and grease to give you a clear – but still private – view of your screen. 


And the screen protection? It’s outstanding! With high-level scratch resistance, this screen protector shields your phone screen from accidental bumps, crushing falls, and other hazards of everyday life. Or to put it in more sustainable terms: It prolongs the lifetime of your phone, postponing the need to produce new phones. This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: In 2024, we reduced the amount of paper in our PanzerGlass® core product packaging design by an average of 66%*. And like all our products, it comes in a recyclable FSC™-certified box.  


With the enclosed EasyAligner made of 100% recycled plastic, installation is a piece of cake (seriously!). To make it even easier, we’ve included step-by-step instructions as well as a QR code for quick access to our online how-to video. And remember: Once installed, you’ll never again fear your phone falling screen-first. This might not happen, but then again … it might! 


The screen protector is Ultra-Wide Fit. This means it covers the front surface of your phone, providing a complete view of your screen while leaving a little room around the edges for a PanzerGlass® case, for example, a fearlessly fashionable case from CARE by PanzerGlass®. And if you’re thinking: “What if my camera lenses get scratched?” Well, help is just a few clicks away: Combine your screen protector and case with PanzerGlass® PicturePerfect or HoopsTM. 


*Reduction from 2022-2024 measured by comparing selected products from the PanzerGlass® core range.

Made with post-consumer recycled materials, the Beats iPhone Case with MagSafe is available in four stylish colorways complemented by bold interior accent colors. The packaging is 100 percent fiber based, and the wood fibers are 100 percent recycled and responsibly sourced.

name: PanzerGlass ® 3-in-1 Pack iPhone 15
description:
Want to protect your phone? I mean REALLY protect your phone? Then this 3-in-1 protection pack from PanzerGlass® is for you! Featuring a PicturePerfect Camera Lens Protector, a wireless charging compatible HardCase and an Ultra-Wide Fit Screen Protector, this pack keeps your phone safe from scratch-creating bumps against sharp-edged corners, phone-cracking falls onto stone-hard pavements and just about anything else life might throw at you. The screen protector even has a smudge-free coating that reduces traces of fingerprints and grease


The HardCase is made with the world’s most advanced plant-based protection material, D3O® Bio, trusted to protect military elite forces and professional athletes alike. Its back is made of 100% recycled plastic, while the frame is made of plastic with 44% plant-based content. The screen protector is also tougher than tough, featuring 3x better scratch resistance. And the PicturePerfect Camera Lens Protector? Well, we don't want to brag, but it’s as strong as they get and keeps your lenses free from scratches and cracks that would leave permanent scars on all future photos.


The 360-degree protection pack prolongs the lifetime of your phone so that one day you can pass it on to someone else who will love it just as much as you do. This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: For this pack, we have managed to reduce the paper packaging by approximately 58%* compared to previous packs. And like all our products, it comes in a recyclable FSC™-certified box.


Installation is also easy. Just apply the camera lens protector, click on the HardCase and use the EasyAligner to mount the screen protector. To make it even easier, we’ve included step-by-step instructions as well as a QR code for quick access to our online how-to video. And once everything is installed, you’ll never again fear the sight of your phone tumbling to the ground. This may not happen, but if it does, you’ll regret not having clicked “add to cart”.


*Estimated by comparing the paper weight with our 2022 packaging.

Galaxy XCover7 Pro features an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance, helping protect against spills, splashes and dusty environment—so you can keep going even when conditions aren't ideal.

With Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus+ and MIL-STD-810H certification, Galaxy XCover7 Pro is designed to withstand extreme temperatures, drops, dust, and vibration—ready to keep up with the toughest of tasks.

Power through the workday uninterrupted
The long-lasting 4,350 mAh battery keeps you powered throughout your workday. When its time to recharge, use 15 W fast charging or swap in a replaceable battery to reduce downtime. For easy, continuous power, simply dock in a POGO charger.

Whether you're out in the field or on-site, Vision Booster keeps Galaxy XCover7 Pro's high-resolution display sharp and vivid. You'll have the clarity and confidence you need to stay focused, wherever the job takes you.

Spend more time working and less time waiting for connectivity. Galaxy XCover7 Pro offers fast and reliable 5G Sub6 and Wi-Fi 6E connectivity for high-speed data access.

Hear every word, even in loud environments
In mission-critical environments like emergency response or industrial sites, multiple nearby devices can cause disruptive audio feedback. Galaxy XCover7 Pros anti-feedback technology actively reduces interference, ensuring stable push-to-talk communication so teams can stay focused without interruption. Paired with tuned stereo speakers, the device delivers reliable, high-quality sound—even in noisy work environments.

More power. More storage
Maximise your work efficiency with Galaxy XCover7 Pro and Snapdragon® 7s Gen 3 processor and 6 GB of memory. Internal storage provides 128 GB for all your work files, photos and videos, and you can add up to 2 TB more with a microSD card.

Circle it to find what you need instantly
Instantly search anything you see on your Galaxy XCover7 Pro with Google. Circle, highlight, scribble or tap any image, video or text to search without switching apps. Quickly get the info you need then get right back to what you're doing.

Photo editing made simple with AI
Keep your business visuals clean and distraction-free with AI Object Eraser. Quickly remove unwanted elements and let AI fill in the background, saving time on edits and ensuring polished images for reports, presentations, and client materials.

Smart actions with AI Select
Save time on scheduling and data entry with AI Select. Simply circle key details like meeting times or deadlines on your screen, and AI instantly add them to your calendar. No manual input, no extra steps.

Your privacy secured with Knox Vault
Safeguard your sensitive data with Samsung Knox Vault, which provides robust encryption and authentication for advanced security.

description:
