Meet Galaxy S22, a smartphone designed for creators who want to capture every moment. It’s packed with next-level innovations you didn’t even know were possible. This is a game-changing device that can create breath-taking
low-light videos to make every day - and night - even more epic. But that’s not all. Stay entertained on an incredibly bright Dynamic AMOLED 2X display even in bright sunlight. With more of what you want, you can do more of what you love.

Expression is tough… and colourful
Galaxy S22 has a sleek yet sturdy Armour Aluminium frame that offers tougher drop and scratch resistance to previous generation materials. Its front is equipped with tough Gorilla® Glass Victus+ for an expansive, balanced display. What’s more, Galaxy S22 comes in 4 stunning colours - Phantom Black, Phantom White, Green and Pink Gold.

Say goodbye to glare
Galaxy S22 brings an incredible viewing experience to match your ultimate video device. It boasts a 6.1" Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with unbelievable brightness. You’ll be able to binge-watch your latest boxset in the park without the sunlight spoiling your view. But it doesn’t stop there. With a 24Hz - 120Hz Adaptive Refresh Rate, scrolling through smoother.

Introducing Nightography
Capture and share epically bright night-time videos and portraits with revolutionary, AI-enhanced cameras. Get your best night shots using the revolutionary Nightography feature, giving you unbelievably bright, blur-free videos. When it comes to stills, the 50MP wide camera automatically adjusts exposure, the wider Optical Image Stabilisation (OIS) keeps your shot steady, and Adaptive Pixel technology uses the Wide lens to combine two results to capture the brightest, clearest, most detailed photos on a Galaxy.

Full stream ahead - fastest Galaxy chip
Galaxy S22 can more than keep up. Samsung’s new lightning-fast 4nm Exynos 2200 processor is the fastest chip ever in a Galaxy smartphone. With unbelievable PC-like power, you’re truly unstoppable. What’s more, Wi-Fi 6 and 5G connectivity gives you faster, more consistent speeds, meaning online gaming and streaming is just effortless.

Mighty, long-lasting battery power
Galaxy S22 has an impressive 3,700mAh battery, optimised to go on, and on, and well... on. It’s so long-lasting that you can go about your day and leave the charger behind. And when you do need to power up, 25W Super Fast Charging 2.0 capability gets you back up and running in no time.

A whole new world of video calling
Experience new ways to watch, chat and be together with Galaxy S22 and Google Duo live sharing. Catch-up and see friends’ reactions as you watch the latest YouTube videos together. Or share your screen and brainstorm project ideas, while still keeping everyone in view

Amazing alone, better together
Galaxy S22 brings you a simplified One UI 4.1, making it easier than ever to express yourself. Style your home screen and keep all your content away from prying eyes and use anti-tracking to stay safe online. Plus, if you lose your phone, SmartThings Find helps you track, remotely block and wipe your device to protect your data. Samsung Pay is great for contactless payments and loyalty cards. And everything works beautifully with Galaxy companion devices and SmartThings - keep tabs on all your Galaxy devices.

name: PanzerGlass SAFE. by ® Screen Protector iPhone 15 Pro | Ultra-Wide Fit
description:
Keep your phone safe from dance floor mishaps, selfies gone wrong and your everyday fumbling, dropping and screen cracking with an original screen protector from SAFE. by PanzerGlass®️. The tempered glass acts as a discrete airbag, protecting your phone by absorbing impact and providing a high level of scratch protection without compromising the functionality and look of your device. It also has a smudge-free coating that reduces traces of fingerprints and grease.


Installation is easy. Usually one attempt is enough, and should you need more, don’t worry, the screen protector can be re-fitted up to 200 times. We’ve even included simple step-by-step instructions as well as a QR code for quick access to our online how-to video. And remember: Once the screen protection is applied, you’ll never again fear the sight of your phone tumbling to the ground screen first. This may not happen, but if it does, you’ll regret not having clicked “add to cart”.


The screen protection prolongs the lifetime of your phone so that one day you can pass it on to someone else who will love it just as much as you do. This is one way of working toward a more sustainable future. Another is to use less packaging: For this screen protector, we have managed to reduce the paper packaging by approximately 30%* compared to previous models. And like all our products, it comes in a recyclable FSC™-certified box.


The screen protector is Ultra-Wide Fit, meaning it covers the front surface of your phone, providing a complete and crystal-clear view of your screen, while still leaving a little room around the edges for a SAFE. by PanzerGlassTM case. If you want 360-degree phone protection, combine the screen protector and case with a PanzerGlass® PicturePerfect camera lens protector.


*Estimated by comparing the paper weight with our 2022 packaging.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 17.3 cm (6.8") Dual SIM 5G USB Type-C 12 GB 256 GB 5000 mAh Black, Titanium
description:
Live Translate. The easiest way to communicate
Thanks to Live Translate, now you can get real-time interpretation while you're on the phone. Break down language barriers like never before — even through messaging. Reply back in your own language — itll get translated on their end too.

Circle it, find it. Just like that
A new way to search is here with Circle to Search. Stumble upon a photo of a plant so beautiful that you just have to know what it is? Circle it with your S Pen or finger and ta-da, you'll get Google Search results. Now you can quickly get an answer without leaving your feed.

Summarise Notes in the blink of an AI
Whether you're typing up a storm or jotting something down, Note Assist makes a long story short. Simply start writing, and format it into a clear, easy-to-review summary later. And when you're looking for an old note, the new covers show simple summaries — keeping your screen looking organised.

Resize it, Retouch it. Just like that
Something out of place? Just move it in post. New AI-powered editing options let you get the photo you wanted, like relocating objects and intelligently filling in the space they left behind.

Armour up with titanium
Check out the upgrade — a durable shield of titanium built right into the frame. Corning® Gorilla® Armour helps protect your screen from scratches to keep your device looking beautiful. And don't let water dampen your spirits. Galaxy S24 Ultra is IP68 water and dust resistant.

Built-in S Pen writes a whole new chapter
The legacy of Galaxy Note is alive and well. Write, tap and navigate with precision your fingers wish they had on the new, flat display.

200MP. Capture details that rival reality
With the most megapixels on a smartphone and AI processing, Galaxy S24 Ultra sets the industry standard for image quality every time you hit the shutter. What's more, the new ProVisual engine recognises objects — improving colour tone, reducing noise and bringing out detail.

Our most powerful Quad Tele zoom yet
Dont let long distance get you down. Now you can get 2x, 3x, 5x and even 10x close-ups with optical or optical quality zoom. Plus, the new, powerful Tele OIS is wider than before to stabilise the shot for less zoom-in blur.

ProVisual engine shoots every night in clear detail
Space Zoom puts you in the middle of the action, even at night. With 1.6x larger pixels and a wider Tele OIS, photos and videos are brighter and more stable — making even distant subjects clearly stunning.

Our most hyper-realistic mobile gameplay yet
Victory can be yours with Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy. Faster processing gives you the power you need for all the gameplay you want. Manifest hyper-realistic shadows and reflections with ray tracing. Then get improved performance and heat dissipation with a Vapor Chamber nearly doubled in size.

All-day battery to play on and on
With massive capacity and greater energy efficiency, Ultra's battery gives you extra life when it matters most — you know, like the epic boss battle you've been gearing up for.

2600 nit display. Our brightest adaptive mobile display under the sun
Our most immersive display comes with some major visibility upgrades. Corning® Gorilla® Armour reduces reflections and improves visual clarity, even in direct sunlight. Then, an improved Vision Booster enhances contrast and colour for a clearly exceptional experience.

Quick Share outside your ecosystem
You're not limited to Galaxy phones. Use QR codes and saved contacts to share with iOS users or far-away friends and family.

Switch effortlessly from iOS
Keep your photos, videos, contacts, calendar and apps with Smart Switch — even if you switch from iOS.

name: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip6
description:
Galaxy AI is here
Your self-expression tool, Galaxy Z Flip6, is more compact and eye-catching, with Galaxy AI and a pro-level 50MP camera that's photoshoot-ready.

MOST COMPACT

BIG IMPACT
Galaxy Z Flip6's new floating design is modern, slim and sleek, creating our most compact smartphone yet.

Galaxy AI is here on Galaxy Foldables

INTERPRETER

Your superior interpreter experience with FlexWindow
Lost in translation? Galaxy Z Flip6 is your passport to communication — working as your personal interpreter.

CHAT ASSIST

Chat flows, even when closed
Send messages directly from the FlexWindow with Chat Assist. Just select from one of the Suggested Replies — curated by context-aware AI.

Chat with Gemini to supercharge your ideas
Thanks to Samsung's longstanding partnership with Google, your Galaxy now comes with the Google Gemini app. Chat with Gemini to get help learning in new ways, writing thank you notes, planning events and more.

Dive into the world of AI

Circle to Search
Simply circle an object or text to get Google Search results.

Live Translate
Get real-time voice translation on various apps when you make a call.

Transcript Assist
Transcribe your recorded conversations into editable text in a flash.

50MP. NEW CAMERA. STUNNING PORTRAITS

Nighttime portraits are lit
Capture stunning shots during the day but also at night — and even in dimly lit areas. Use Nightography to ensure every photo shines with detail, thanks to ProVisual Engine.

The most powerful camera on a Galaxy Z Flip, now with AI
The upgraded 50MP wide rear camera processes your pics through the ProVisual Engine to capture stunning scenes and richer portraits.

FlexCam. Capture your best angle
FlexCam uses Auto Zoom to either zoom in or out on subjects, and provides a preview on the FlexWindow for a hands-free selfie experience.

Rear cam portraits hit different
Use the FlexWindow to give your subjects a preview as you take their photo in 50 megapixels. Then, snap a pic to capture bright and detailed portraits even when backlit.

PHOTO ASSIST
Effortless editing. Courtesy of Galaxy AI

Generative Edit
Tap into your creativity with Generative Edit for Photo Assist to move, resize or delete whole objects from your photos and fill in the background where they used to be.

Instant Slow-mo
Put focus on key moments by applying slow motion to your videos and share or save it.

Live Effect
Add depth to give your pics all-new life.

Galaxy Z Flip's longest lasting battery
Meet our biggest Flip battery ever. Paired with Snapdragon® 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy, you can talk, text or game to your heart's content — all day long.

First ever Vapour Chamber on a Galaxy Z Flip
Keep things cool, calm and running smoothly with a Vapour Chamber that dissipates heat quickly.
